title: mime-tree/header_typed.rs: private helpers missing doc comments
description:
Why this exists: mime_tree/src/header_typed.rs contains three items without doc comments: the private fn convert_addr, and the private methods HeaderDateTime::to_mail_parser() and HeaderDateTime::from_mail_parser(). The Rust coding standard requires doc comments on everything rustdoc can document, including module-private items.

What goes wrong: convert_addr is a conversion function whose argument types and return type indicate what it does, but doc comments should state what it maps (an AddressHeader from mail-parser) to (an EmailAddress from this crate) and note any edge cases (e.g. what happens with group addresses). to_mail_parser() and from_mail_parser() are bridging functions between internal and external representations; their purpose must be inferred from their body.

Location: mime-tree/src/header_typed.rs — fn convert_addr, impl HeaderDateTime fn to_mail_parser, impl HeaderDateTime fn from_mail_parser.

Fix: add one-line doc comments to each. For example: /// Convert a mail-parser address header entry to an EmailAddress.
close_reason: P2 polish: private helper doc comments are nice-to-have but not a contract issue. The public API is documented.
